description: Turn a verified NudgeOnly painpoint into a tiny worker receipt request or WakePass escalation candidate. Deterministic bridge only: no writes, no ownership decision, no completion state.

ack_status.description: Optional ACK status such as missing, stale, received, or blocked.

context.description: Optional local context. Keep it small and non-secret.

created_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the source handoff or request.

event_text.description: Source event, blocker, handoff, or state-card text. Keep it small and non-secret.

now.description: Optional ISO timestamp used for deterministic TTL checks.

owner.description: Optional existing owner evidence. The bridge does not invent or decide owners.

owner_last_seen_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the current owner's last real check-in. Past TTL is treated as an expired ownership lease.

owner_silent_minutes.description: Optional owner silence age in minutes. Past TTL is treated as an expired ownership lease.

painpoint_detected.description: Whether a painpoint was detected by trusted evidence or nudgeonly_api.

painpoint_type.description: stale_ack, duplicate_wake, unclear_owner, noisy_thread, missing_proof, or none.

proof_status.description: Optional proof status such as missing, present, stale, or blocked.

source_id.description: Optional upstream event, dispatch, PR, issue, or wake identifier.

target.description: Optional human target label such as PR #705 or a dispatch ID.

ttl_minutes.description: Minutes before missing ACK/proof becomes an escalation request. Default: 60.

worker.description: Optional worker override when a trusted lane already named one.

name: nudgeonly_receipt_bridge
